options.name: Bless
options.summary: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to their attack rolls and saving throws. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

options.name: Cure Wounds
options.summary: Touch a creature: it regains Hit Points.

options.name: Guidance
options.summary: Touch an ally and name a skill: they add 1d4 to checks with that skill while the spell lasts. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

options.name: Guiding Bolt
options.summary: A spell attack with radiant light. A hit deals radiant damage, and the next attack roll against the target before your next turn ends has Advantage.

options.name: Healing Word
options.summary: A creature you can see within 60 feet regains Hit Points. Quick: a Bonus Action, so you still have your action.

options.name: Sacred Flame
options.summary: Radiant flame falls on a creature you can see: it makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes radiant damage. Cover doesn't help it.

options.name: Shield of Faith
options.summary: A creature you choose gains +2 AC. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

options.name: Spare the Dying
options.summary: A creature at 0 Hit Points within 15 feet becomes Stable: no more death saving throws.

options.name: Cleric Divine Spark
options.summary: Channel Divinity at a creature within 30 feet: heal it, or have it make a Constitution saving throw against radiant or necrotic damage (half on a success).

options.name: Dash
options.summary: You gain extra movement equal to your Speed this turn; a second Dash in the same turn adds it again.

options.name: Disengage
options.summary: Your movement this turn provokes no opportunity attacks.

options.name: Dodge
options.summary: Until the start of your next turn, attacks against you have Disadvantage and you have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws; you lose this while you are Incapacitated or your Speed is 0.

options.name: Help Assist Attack Roll
options.summary: Pick a foe within 5 feet of you: the next attack roll an ally makes against it before your next turn has Advantage.

options.name: Help Stabilize
options.summary: Try to steady a dying creature within 5 feet with a Wisdom (Medicine) check. On a success it stops making death saving throws.

options.name: Mace attack
options.summary: Attack a creature within the weapon's reach. A hit deals the weapon's damage.

options.name: Unarmed Attack
options.summary: Punch, kick or headbutt a creature within your reach. A hit deals bludgeoning damage of 1 plus your Strength modifier.

options.name: Potion of Healing
options.summary: Drink it, or give it to a creature within 5 feet. The drinker regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.
